POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

3. When learning Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.

4. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after electronic systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for electronic systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.

5. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to computer aided drawing.

6. When learning Surface Development of pyramids, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Development of pyramids.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Development of pyramids.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Development of pyramids.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.

7. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

9. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Management of Road Transport.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Management of Road Transport.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Management of Road Transport.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

12. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle batteries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Road Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Developmen t of prisms and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Development of pyramids and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
